lines.t: Because I could not stop for Death —
lines.p: Because I could not stop for Death

lines.t: Hope is the thing with feathers
lines.p: Hope is the thing with feathers

lines.t: I celebrate myself, and sing myself,
O Captain! my Captain! our fearful trip is done,
Tyger Tyger, burning bright,
To see a World in a Grain of Sand
Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary,
And the silken, sad, uncertain rustling of each purple curtain
I wandered lonely as a cloud
lines.p: I Wandered Lonely as a Cloud

lines.t: The world is too much with us; late and soon,
lines.p: The World Is Too Much with Us

lines.t: Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair!
O wild West Wind, thou breath of Autumn's being,
A thing of beauty is a joy for ever:
Season of mists and mellow fruitfulness,
She walks in beauty, like the night
Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
lines.p: The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

lines.t: In Xanadu did Kubla Khan a stately pleasure-dome decree:
Does the road wind up-hill all the way? Yes, to the very end.
Ring out, wild bells, to the wild sky,
The world is charged with the grandeur of God.
Loveliest of trees, the cherry now is hung with bloom along the bough,
The tide rises, the tide falls,
lines.p: The Tide Rises, the Tide Falls

lines.t: I am the master of my fate, I am the captain of my soul.
Gather ye rosebuds while ye may,
lines.p: To the Virgins, to Make Much of Time

lines.t: Death, be not proud, though some have called thee
But at my back I always hear Time's wingèd chariot hurrying near;
